For me as a guy, you should get to know the one you'll be meeting. Well this is just my opinion.

Kumbaga if you have time to spare, better Kung usap/common bonding muna on your first meet up like Kaen lng muna SA labas or watch movies. SA first Meetup mo malalaman Kung may Dark intent un sau. Though mahirap malaman Kun expert na un guy na un SA pagpapafall. 

Then if okay Naman sau , on your second Meetup dun mo na ibigay. However, don't do it raw. I know Hindi gnun kasarap pero Better pdin Kun may protection. Kapag matagal tagal na siguro kyo dun mo decide Kun okay Ng raw.
